0.0: I heard you need to go downstream. If we succeed in #bliberating this city of dreams#k, you will be able to achieve your goal as well.
0.1: Won't you lend us your strength?

yes.0: Thank you. Talk to Gray Mask for details.

no.0: I see... Well, tell me when you change your mind.

1.0: Our goal is twofold. We must #bprotect the awakened ones#k like us and #bliberate the city from Lucid's dream#k.
1.1: Your first task should be locating the other awakened ones and bringing them back here. They will likely be hidden among the dreaming townsfolk.

yes.0: Talk to Protective Mask when you're ready. She'll be waiting for you.
